title: 1 本能跟过来了2 有点离谱
slug: 在诡异世界变成蜘蛛精
content_zh:
：本能跟过来了。
幽静。
阴暗。
天空是雾蒙蒙，空气中到处弥漫着水汽，仿佛在水边，呼吸间都是粘稠的湿意，这股湿意仿佛有意识一般往肺部使劲粘连。
山洞，山洞里面是监牢，十分寂静，监牢是一种类似于石质的栏杆，栏杆底部有淡淡的粘滑的青苔。
贺堪睁开眼睛看见的就是这副场景。
监牢是一间一间单独，每一间监牢里面都有一个昏迷的人，或男或女，大多都昏迷的躺在地上，衣服十分简陋，短打布衣，是古代的衣服，样式与贺堪记忆中的现代服饰样式完全不同。
看到这里，贺堪忍不住深深叹口气，他知道，自己又重生了。
这已经是第三世了，他完全搞不清楚到底谁这么捉弄他，连死两次都死不掉，未免也太过分了。
第一世的他就是个普通男大学生，在宿舍里打游戏打到一半猝死，睁开眼自己就到了一个上古蛮荒时代。
第二世是个各种神话传说都盛行的上古时代，每个种族都分部落而聚居，有着各自的信仰，贺堪十分不幸的成为一种名叫佛骨魔蛛的巨大蜘蛛，据说是因为他们的先祖曾经吞食了一位佛陀，因此而得名。
对此，贺堪有点不相信。
主要是他的长辈们就不太像话，天天靠着佛骨魔蛛是神话种的身份各种坑蒙拐骗，什么诡异啊，不详啊，不少都被他们供奉诱惑然后直接被坑杀。
这么狡猾怎么可能是吞食佛陀的傻子嘛，佛陀是那么好吃的吗？
第二世的死因很简单，单纯就是蛮荒种族之间的部落战争，他刚成年就被派了过去，十分不幸的遇到了敌方蟒蜥中的一位强者，直接就被打死了。
再次睁开眼睛就是现在。
活活被撕扯开的疼痛仿佛还在身体上弥漫，贺堪揉了揉额头，想起自己临死之前母蛛赶过来时候的样子，人脸上都露出六只蛛眼了，以母蛛的修为绝对不可能犯这样的小错，恐怕还是过于惊慌的缘故。
自己的蛛子在面前活活被杀死。
贺堪已经不敢想象母蛛的心情了。
想到这里，贺堪就有点庆幸自己是只雄蛛，部落里的雄蛛成年后都会离开部落，自己死后，母蛛也能想成他是离开了部落，母蛛性格坚毅，十有八九会帮他报仇，报完仇后也能很快进入新生活。

这是那个蛮荒时代每一个兽种的本能，神话种也不例外。
“……呼。”
贺堪很快整理了心情，不再继续沉湎于过往记忆，上辈子的经验告诉他，十有八九是回不去了，死了就真的死了，他只是转世轮回没喝孟婆汤而已。
所以这一世是什么身份？
贺堪低头环顾，试图在自己所在的监牢中寻找自己身份的线索。
下一秒，贺堪只感觉自己脑子被什么东西狠狠地撞了一下，一片空白，随后，数不清的信息冒出来，一时间冲刷他的理智。
又过了一会儿，贺堪这才理清楚自己的记忆。
贺堪表情有些奇怪，这第三世的身体——是一个半傻子，准确的说，是个大部分理智偶尔会不清醒的人，更关键的是这一世的脸与他的脸一模一样。
这不得不让贺堪怀疑这是不是某个世界的他自己，否则未免太过于巧合了。
至于为什么会来到这里。
是被拐卖，准确的说，是在去大启城当术师的时候，没想到正巧赶上变傻，脑子不清醒，被路上的商队抓住，沦为了诡物的祭品。
这一世同样有着超自然力量，人类在这个世界上没有占据主流，占据强势地位的是各种各样强大力量的诡物。
不过人类是种会主动学习的生物，在诡物成为食物链最顶端的时候，人类也随即出现根据诡物力量而诞生的术师。
贺堪抬头看了看自己所处的监牢，整个监牢都潮湿无比，呼吸间都仿佛带着浓重的水汽，时间久了，贺堪闻到的都是河水的腥气，让人作呕，几乎估计在水底的程度。
目前不知道具体情况，监牢的石柱不像是普通石头，他现在就是一个普通人，只能看一步走一步。
贺堪捏了捏自己的手，很可惜，曾经感受丰盈的力量荡然无存。
山洞外面。
传来“啪嚓啪擦”
的声音，像是好几个人的脚步声，在慢慢的走进山洞，那种声音也很像金属与石块相互碰撞的声音。
贺堪第一时间闭上眼睛，重新躺回原来的位置。

贺堪的监牢位于最前面，从脚步声进入山洞的那一刻，贺堪就嗅到了浓重的腥气，像是鱼类身上的味道，不，是死鱼，菜市场中那些死鱼散发的味道。
“砰砰！
content_en:
: Instinct is coming.
quiet.
dark.
The sky was foggy, and the air was filled with water vapor everywhere. It was as if you were at the water's edge, and your breath was filled with thick moisture. This moisture seemed to stick to the lungs consciously.
Inside the cave is a prison, which is very quiet. The prison is a kind of stone railing with a touch of slimy moss at the bottom.
He Kan opened his eyes and saw this scene.
The prisons were separated into separate cells. In each cell, there was an unconscious person, male or female. Most of them were lying on the ground in a coma. The clothes were very simple. The short-sleeved cloth clothes were ancient clothes, and the style was completely different from the modern clothes in He Kan's memory.
Seeing this, He Kan couldn't help but sigh deeply. He knew that he was reborn again.
This was already his third life, and he had no idea who was teasing him like this. It would be too much to die twice.
In his first life, he was an ordinary male college student. He died suddenly while playing games in the dormitory. When he opened his eyes, he was transported to an ancient and barbaric era.
The second life was an ancient era where all kinds of myths and legends were prevalent. Each race lived in tribes and had their own beliefs. Unfortunately, Hekan became a giant spider called the Buddha Bone Demon Spider. It is said that their ancestors once swallowed a Buddha, hence the name.
He Kan didn't believe it.
The main reason is that his elders are not very talkative. They use the Buddha Bone Demon Spider's identity as a mythical species to deceive and deceive them every day. It's so weird and unknown. Many of them were enshrined by them and then directly killed.
How could such a cunning fool be the one who ate the Buddha? Is the Buddha so delicious?
The cause of death in the second life was very simple. It was simply a tribal war between barbaric races. He was sent there when he was just an adult. Unfortunately, he met a strong man among the enemy pythons and was killed directly.
Open your eyes again now.
The pain of being torn apart still seemed to permeate his body. He Kan rubbed his forehead and remembered the way the mother spider rushed over before he died. Six spider eyes were visible on the face. It was absolutely impossible for the mother spider to make such a small mistake because of the mother spider's cultivation. I'm afraid it was because of too much panic.
His own spider was killed alive in front of him.
He Kan could no longer imagine the mother spider's mood.
Thinking of this, He Kan felt a little lucky that he was a male spider. The male spiders in the tribe would leave the tribe when they reached adulthood. After his death, the female spider could also imagine that he had left the tribe. The female spider had a resolute personality and would most likely help him get revenge. After taking revenge, he could quickly enter a new life.
This was the instinct of every beast species in that barbaric era, and the mythical species was no exception.
"...Phew."
He Kan quickly sorted out his mood and no longer indulged in past memories. The experience of his previous life told him that nine times out of ten, he would never be able to go back. If he died, he would really die. He just reincarnated and did not drink Meng Po soup.
So what is your identity in this life?
He Kan lowered his head and looked around, trying to find clues to his identity in the prison where he was.
The next second, He Kan only felt that his brain was hit hard by something, and it went blank. Then, countless information emerged, washing away his reason for a while.
After a while, He Kan finally clarified his memory.
He Kan's expression was a little strange. The body of this third life was that of a semi-idiot. To be precise, he was a person who was mostly sane and occasionally not clear-headed. More importantly, the face in this life was exactly the same as his.
This had to make He Kan wonder if this was himself in a certain world, otherwise it would be too much of a coincidence.
As for why you came here.
He was abducted, to be precise, when he went to Daqi City to work as a magician, he unexpectedly happened to become stupid and lost his mind. He was caught by a caravan on the road and became a sacrifice to a strange creature.
thisI also have supernatural powers. Human beings do not occupy the mainstream in this world. What occupy a strong position are all kinds of powerful monsters.
However, humans are creatures that can actively learn. When monsters became the top of the food chain, magicians born based on the power of monsters also appeared in humans.
He Kan raised his head and looked at the prison where he was. The entire prison was extremely humid, and his breath seemed to be filled with thick water vapor. After a long time, all He Kan could smell was the fishy smell of river water, which was nauseating, almost like being under the water.
The specific situation is unknown at the moment. The stone pillars in the prison are not like ordinary stones. He is now an ordinary person and can only watch one step at a time.
He Kan squeezed his hand. Unfortunately, the power that he once felt full of power was gone.
Outside the cave.
There was a "pop, snap, snap, snap, snap!"
The sound was like the footsteps of several people walking slowly into the cave. The sound was also like the sound of metal and stone colliding with each other.
He Kan closed his eyes immediately and lay back in his original position.
He Kan's prison was located at the front. The moment he heard footsteps entering the cave, He Kan smelled a strong fishy smell, like the smell of fish, no, dead fish, the smell of dead fish in the vegetable market.
“Bang bang!
